title: Exact Oracle-Excess Frontier for Delayed Response-Adaptive Randomization with Deterministic Outcome Lags

proof_attempt_summary: Discovery discharged the all-policy/all-estimator asymptotic identity D=G, necessary-and-sufficient zero-loss geometry, a certified scalar controller with O(N^-1/4) implementation, and exact exposure-preserving cadence repair. Math and decision reviews passed without findings; the general referee capped the fixed-wave Gaussian deterministic-lag benchmark at subfield (7.0 below the field threshold 7.4). No theorem collapsed, but no same-topic field repair remained; formalization was not started, and a future re-anchor must add broader delay scope, exact finite-cohort theory, or calibrated implementation.
tldr: The exact maturation frontier is the all-policy, all-estimator identity \(D(T,r,L,\delta,R)=\lim_{N\to\infty}D_N=G\) proved in Theorem~\ref{thm:chronological-reduction}. Four public calendar masses reduce the value to a three-scalar robust allocation problem. Two necessary-and-sufficient inequalities characterize zero oracle excess; the conditional repair constraint can bind at an interior fast-arm scale. Theorem~\ref{thm:certified-repair-value} gives the exact scalar reachability value and a terminating arbitrary-accuracy computation with certified error brackets and feasible controllers. Its residual-only trial sequence attains supremum normalized oracle excess \(G+O(N^{-1/4})\). Theorem~\ref{thm:minimum-cadence-repair} gives the exact exposure-preserving enrollment-repair cost, rational-calendar feasibility and attainment tests, and a certified construction approaching the infimum. The converse covers every original predictable policy and terminal estimator; the attaining pooled estimator retains every matured observation. Larger cohorts cannot eliminate positive oracle excess imposed by insufficient allocation-repair capacity.
gap: Published delayed CARA work gives sufficient calibration and one-design efficiency guarantees. It leaves the exact fixed-calendar information and repair price in this deterministic-lag Gaussian-marginal benchmark undetermined.
fill: Observed-marginal invariance, a likelihood converse and uniform residual-policy risk transfer connect the original all-procedure experiment to chronological reachability. The zero-loss geometry and a certified value computation translate the frontier into prospective enrollment decisions.
